given.O: The centre of the small star inside the red rosette.
given.A: A point of that small star.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s FEZ7 drawing. Its tile corners were snapped to the square-root-of-two grid in small-star-radius units. The unit-star opening is shared with the other Moroccan reconstructions. After it every line, the tile’s sides too, is drawn through a crossing of earlier lines and turned round O. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The tile edges follow the plain drawing. The colours follow Wichmann’s drawing in the Modern Moroccan palette. No photograph was checked.

credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His reference is a photo by W. Betsch of a pattern in Fès, sent to him in a personal communication; the building is not named.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at C and D. The horizontal line crosses the circle at B on the left. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at E. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a line through O at 90° to line OE. The circle crosses the four lines through O at S1 to S8.
Draw the star at O as two squares.

parts.text: Draw a straight line through S1 and S3, S3 and S5, S5 and S7, and S7 and S1. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.
Draw a straight line through S2 and S4, S4 and S6, S6 and S8, and S8 and S2. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.

steps.text: The line from S7 to S1 crosses the line from S2 to S4 at P1. Draw a vertical line through P1. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P1 at P2. The line from S2 to S4 crosses the vertical line through P1, turned by 315°, at P3. Draw a horizontal line through P2. Draw a vertical line through P3. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P3 at P4. Draw a horizontal line through P4. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P4 at P5. The vertical line through P1 crosses the horizontal line through P2, turned by 45°, at P6. Draw a vertical line through P5. Draw a horizontal line through P6. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P5 at P7. The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P6 at P8. Draw a horizontal line through P7. Draw a vertical line through P8. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P8 at P9. Draw a horizontal line through P9. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P9 at P10. The vertical line through P1 crosses the vertical line through P5, turned by 135°, at P11. Draw a vertical line through P10. Draw a horizontal line through P11. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P11 at P12. Draw a vertical line through P12. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P12 at P13. The line from S2 to S4 crosses the horizontal line through P9, turned by 225°, at P14. Draw a horizontal line through P13. Draw a vertical line through P14. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P14 at P15. Draw a horizontal line through P15. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P16. Draw a vertical line through P16. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The horizontal line through P11 crosses the vertical line through P16 at P17. Draw a line through P13 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P17 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P15 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The vertical line through P1, turned by 315°, crosses the horizontal line through P15 at P18. Draw a line through P16 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P18 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The horizontal line through O crosses the vertical line through P12, turned by 45°, at T. Draw a vertical line through T. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They close the rosettes, the stars and the pieces between them.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. A red rosette sits at the centre of every tile, a white star at every corner.
